description: This file contains cryptographic functions implementing 64-bit CFB mode encryption/decryption for 3DES (Triple DES) in the 'decrepit' directory of BoringSSL, specifically the DES CFB mode functions.

methods.name: DES_ede3_cfb64_encrypt
methods.description: Performs 64-bit CFB mode encryption or decryption for 3DES, processing input data with internal state management.

methods.name: DES_ede3_cfb_encrypt
methods.description: Performs variable-sized (numbits) CFB mode encryption or decryption for 3DES, supporting different bit lengths and internal state updates.
